readme: Hand-maintained standing ratification backlog. Anthony maintains this file by hand; the boot-pack assembler only READS it and PROJECTS its items into the unified decision queue (section 3). The queue ROUTES attention -- it never absorbs, performs, or clears ratification. Merge is Anthony's. Add real standing items as they arise (WITHOUT the 'placeholder' flag) and delete items once ratified. Each item: {id, summary, kind (ratification|merge|ruling), waiting_since (ISO date), source, placeholder?}. OPTIONAL 'placeholder': set true ONLY on the seed shape below -- the assembler SKIPS placeholder entries (they never enter the live inbox) and instead records one provenance footer line in the queue section noting the seed was skipped. Real items must NOT carry this flag.

items.summary: PLACEHOLDER -- replace with a real standing ratification item (e.g. a parked cross-repo ratification awaiting Anthony's sign-off). This seed exists so the assembler has a valid feed shape to project.
